claims: Deductions reduce your assessable income, which reduces tax payable.
Keep all receipts and records for expenses over $300.
whys: Deductions reduce taxable income (assessable income minus deductions), not assessable income. The WATO page on the same site says 'A deduction lowers your taxable income'. Left unchanged because it is a terminology/fact correction.

The ATO $300 rule applies to total work-related expense claims: above $300 in total you need written evidence for all claims, and records must be kept for every claim. Reading it as a per-expense threshold misstates the rule. $300 is also a hardcoded figure, not from a constant.
constants: a records-threshold constant in lib/constants (none exists today)
